A polish release for the installer and uninstaller.

### What's changed
- **A proper-looking installer.** Setup now shows the program's own icon and colours instead of the stock pictures.
- **Clearer setup pages.** The Ready page lists the Microsoft components Setup installs first (the .NET 10 runtimes, and WebView2 if it's missing), and "Start automatically when I sign in to Windows" has its own heading.
- **Safer uninstall.** If the program is running, the uninstaller now asks it to save and close by itself before removing it. Your people, templates and settings are always kept.
- **Full name everywhere.** Windows notifications and Task Manager now show "ID Card Printing Software Free".

### Updating
Already on 3.0.0? An administrator will see **Version 3.0.1 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it; it installs over the top and keeps everything.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.1.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
